FirstGraderBoy.sheet: KM-C01_first_grade_boy (its four views, Gemini; its model and rig, meshy.ai)
FirstGraderBoy.parts_caption: Its outfit parts recoloured as the game dresses them (ModelOutfit): the shirt, the legwear and the randoseru take the palette; the yellow cap, hair, skin, socks and shoes stay

motion_notes.stroll: Walking: WalkerAnimator's stroll, 24 frames a stride (1.3 s at 0.9 m/s)
motion_notes.chat: Chatting when stopped: hands going, nodding (one nod, 3.3 s)
motion_notes.wait: Waiting at the kerb: a slow sway of the head and body (15.7 s)

checks: one skin: one head, one cap, one randoseru, two arms and legs; looked at in all eight views, Top and Bottom too
29 edges with one face, Meshy's own (along the randoseru's straps, the cap's edge and the waist, by the bones they ride on); no hole shows in any of the eight views or the motions
Depth from each part's own width
a model meshy.ai built from its four views (front, back, left, right), in the round
every side made from a picture of that side; the game sees them from the side as they walk, and the back as they walk away

1.17 m tall (a six-year-old), 13,402 triangles (a passer-by's budget: 14,000), a 2048 atlas; in the game its neck at 1.04 (the player kid's 1.3, a grown-up's 1.586: four-fifths of the kid, two-thirds of a grown-up, C13)
no background in its texture; the outline as built (looked at in the eight views)
none seen in the eight views or any motion frame (looked at every second frame at full size)
Mia's realism, a Japanese six-year-old's face (the prompts' rules, C24, C25): no anime look
no logo or brand on the clothes, cap or randoseru

the hems held in the polish (cut freely they left dark flaps over the knees, C28); the boy's yellow cover painted plain in its own yellow over its middle, as his picture draws it (meshy.ai had painted a buckle and folds there); the waistband joined to the legwear (in another outfit it stayed navy as a belt, C22); the randoseru's light evened (its leather's highlights and creases read as camouflage in any other colour, C22); all found in the audit's loud-outfit renders (a teal shirt, mustard legwear, a magenta randoseru) from every side
Meshy's rig (Spine02, Spine01, Spine, neck, head_end: C26) merged into the game's 17 bones, with the Bag and Nose markers; posed by CharacterRig in every motion

one skin bound to the bones: no seam at the hips, knees, shoulders or neck in any frame of the stroll, with the game's torso turning (CharacterRig.Torso: the pelvis against the chest, C19); the head's nod in the chat folds nothing (C15)
never below the ground; the lowest point rises 0.9 to 2.9 % of its height through the stride: the game's stroll swings the legs from the hip, as every passer-by's, and CharacterRig only lifts

each outfit part looked at in a loud outfit unlike its own from all eight sides (C22): the shirt, the legwear with its waistband, the randoseru each their own; the cap, the cover, socks and shoes left as they are
